insurer_name: Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. Ltd.
permanent_exclusions: Suicide, attempted suicide or self-inflicted injury
Under the influence of liquor or drugs
Breach of law with criminal intent
Aviation/ballooning except as fare-paying passenger in licensed standard aircraft
Naval, military or air force operations
War, civil war, invasion, terrorism (as carved out)
notable_exclusions_summary: Group personal accident policy excludes self-inflicted injury, intoxication, illegal acts, hazardous aviation, motor racing, military operations, HIV/AIDS, war, nuclear and maternity-related expenses.
claim_process_summary: Claims must be settled or rejected within 30 days of receipt of last necessary document. Investigation cases close within 45 days. Penal interest at 2% above RBI bank rate applies on delays.
